ma nga bcas ra'i 'brug rgyal khab 'di sngoni gong las rang chos ldan gyi rgyal khab dang chos lugs yang nang pa zer ga ra dkon mchog gsum lu skyabs su bzung mi tsang tsang in/ lhag par du yang nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab 'di nang spyir darkani mchog gi thugs rje dang 'bangs mi ser gyi bsode nams spyi mthun las blam sprul sku mang rabs cig byon te dbang lung khrid la sogs pa gnang ste chos kyi ming gzhi btsugs te yodapa las ga ra gis ma ṇi dang badzra gu ru bgyang ma shes mi gcig yang med/ de'i nang las yang gzhi rten shes yoni lhab mi tshu gis snga phyi thun gyi dpe cha cig nges par du khag che bas zer yang nas yang du slab las blam kun bzang dbang 'dus lu zhuwa bzhin du blam gis yang thun gyi dpe cha phyogs bsgrigs 'bad gnang mi 'di lu nga las yid ches dang dga' tshor sbom yod zer zhu ni in/gzhi rten shes yoni sde tshan gyi mgo 'dren thog lagathun gyi dpe cha bkram spel 'bad mi 'di gis gzhi rten shes yoni lhagami rkyangam cigagis ma do bar slobagrwa khag gi slob phrug bu dang bumo tshu gi shes rab kyi mig to dang nyon mongs pa'i nad dang bar chad bsal/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas las grol te bde ba dang ldan/ bsam pa'i done 'grub ste ga ra lu phan thogs 'ong mno nga las re ba dang smoni lam yode/ bkra shis bde legs/tshodze 777/ 7rdzolo1tshoblon po ngasargyas dngos grub/gso ba dang shes rig lhan khag

mdun gyi nam mkhar 'od lnga'i klong : seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng : sku gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dngos: rtsa ba'i bla ma padma 'byung : dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi khro'i nyams: pad zhwa gsang phod chos gos dang : za 'og ber smug brjid par gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang : g.yone pas bhandha tshe bum bsnams: gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ 'chang : rdo rje'i skyil krung dang bcas te: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las: rtsa gsum chos srung rab 'byams kun: 'phro 'du'i gzi byin lam me ba: mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur: de las skyabs su 'gro ba 'di nga dang ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can cha mnyam gyi sgo gsum zer lus ngagayid gsum gus pa chen po gis byang chub zer sangs rgyas ma thob tshun 61 rgyan rin po che lu skyabs su mchi'o zer mno bsam btang dgos/ na 31: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang 17

bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can snas: byang chub bar du skyabs ༄/ mchi: tshar gsum btang / sems bskyed 'di/ drin can pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba sems can ga ra khamasagasum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngalalas bsgral zhinam las gu ru rin po che'i zhing khams zangasamadogadapal gyiri bo lubakod ni'i don lu nga gis gu ru rin po che lugasolawa bto sbe snying po badzra gu ru bzla zer bgyang ni in zer mno bsamagatang dgos/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas baji/bas nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca'o:tshar gsum btang / yan lag bdun pa 'di/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gre( gshegs: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'gul : nyams chag sdog sgrib mtshal zhong bshags: gsang sngags bsgrubs la rjes yi rang : smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya 48

ngan mi 'da' bzhugasu gsol: snying po sems can don du baspo yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: 'a gsha gam gsumabatang / tshig bdun gsol 'debs 'di/ lha: blas rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar chesang po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru padma siddhi lha: tshar gsum btang ba'i shul lu/ bsam pa lhun grub bsdus pa 'di/ skyabs gnas na/na 'dus thetsu rgyan rin po cher: bzod med gdung shugs drag yos gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyengs su sol: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobes: zer gsolawa snying gis pa las bto sbe/ then 'gri:lhu badzra gu ru 19

/ spyir yan lag bdun pa 'di/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi 'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i spyod lam stobes dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mcho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar 24

gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstosnad/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /brketod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stostobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad 25

bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' stoni gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdu la snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal re( rab sbyar gserdzol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams 26

cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /7/ mas sobadun ma 'di/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥlha/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ 61 badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyode/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ gasku1 ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ smo po rin po che/ glang po rin yo che/ rta mchog rin ngo che/ dmag dngon rin yo che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu 27

ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin yo me'i gdugs/ gyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'gror phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha chogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshorags dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyicas/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gasku(la/ /sa gzhi 〉(sa kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyodi par 〈snag /i dam ratna maṇḍa la kai 28

niryā ta yā mi/ mnyes byed maṇḍal bzang po 'di 'bul bas/ /byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lon pa dang / /srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing / /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /7/ yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa 'di/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gserdzol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bstsod 'o/ /tsa maṇḍal bsdus pa 'di/ sa gzhi spyo1sa kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /i dam ratna maṇḍa la kai 29

niryā ta yā mi/7/ ja mchod bsdus pa spyir btang / thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bu brjid pa'i sku/ khri1kya rgyal po'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /tre/ rnying ma'i lus lu/ kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī sing / /padmā ka ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs gnyags gter stod brgya rtsa serdzogs/ /bka' gter bla ma rnams la mchormed pa 'bul/ /༈ bka' brgyud kyi lugs lu/ rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro dang / /mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa pa/ /sna phu pa dang dpal ldan 'brug pa sku1gas/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /30

myo/ chang mchod bsdus pa spyir btang 'di/ bla'i zhi/ཿ bhū/ gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di/ /rtsa gsum lha dang sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogos/ /gdon bgegs lan chags 'go ba'i lha rnams la/ /gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /7/ chang mchod bsdus pa bka' brgyud kyi lugs lu/ ha las lta ba'i mdangs mtshar po/ /ho shi sdom pa'i dri zhim pa/ /hrīḥ 'u myang na bda' ba'i bcud/ /dpa' bo mnyes pa'i dza gad 'di/ /bde ba chen po'i zhing khams kyi/ /ye shes ro mchog ma lus pa/ /dzaḥlha baṃ ho gnyis med par/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ āḥlha/ 'di ltar mchod rdzas dam pa 'di/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma mchod/ /dkar rgyud thams cad dgyes par rol/ /sku gsung thugs 34

kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /'di ltar mchod rdzas dam pa 'di/ /dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes par rol/ /grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub stsol/ /'di ltar mchod rdzas dam pa 'di/ /'phrin las rtsa ba chos skyong mchod/ /dam can rgya mtsho dgyes par rol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub gyur cig /mchosgod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dmigs pa med par zhi gyur na sa/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thosgob par 31ga /'di rgyal ba gong ma'i gsung las in/ /snye/ sto mchod bsdus pa spyir btang 'di/ 31 āḥlha/ stod pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabs gnas dkoni mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /sangs 32

rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi yone tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun sku(na tan bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar 3rteg /bdag sdusags 'khor bces tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dkon mchog gsum po nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /dkon mchog gsum po rgyun du mchod pa yis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs 'jug par 3rteg /7 gser skyems bsdus pa spyir btang 'di/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ/ blas āḥsbru/ tshar gsum gtang / gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ hūṃ/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang / /bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ /khyad par bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i 3 3

tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'gyor phrin las mdzod/ /rje yi mgur lha 'bangs kyi srog lha dang / /brtan ma bcu gnyis la serdzogs gangs ljosnengs 'dir/ /dregs pa lha srin gnyan po ma lus rnams/ /gser skyems ne /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang / /sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'gror phrin las mdzod/ /tsa/ sde brgyad gser skyems bsdus pa 'di/ dredags bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / /skyabs gnas dkerdzon mchog gsum yo dang / /yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong dang / /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad dang / /srid pa'i gza' mchog ki kyang dang / /spar sme sa bdag hal 34

khyi dang / /lo zla zhag dus za ma'i lha/ /yul lha gter srung ma lus pa/ /'khor bcas gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /bdag sogs grogs dang phrin las mdzod/ khāe/ sa yul 'di na gnas pa yi/ /lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang / /yul lha gnyan dang ma resna gnyan/ /yul bdag mthu chen bzhugs pa rnams/ /rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /'khor 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig /snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag 'bul/ /phyi ma legs pa'i zhu skyems 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di/ /rtsa gsum lha dang sde brgyad 'byung po'i chogs/ /gdone bgegs lan chags 'grerdzo ba'i lha rnams 35

la/ /gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /chos srung yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag bsam don ma lus grub par mdzod// //snye/ bsang mchod mdor bsdus 'di/ rang spyan ras gzigs sgom dgos/ bsang rdzas ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ gis bsang ste/ the'i zhi/ཿlha gis byin gyisabarlabs sbe/ rtsa ga༄/ma chos skyong gter gyi bdag /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / /bsam done myur 'grub phrin las mdzod/ /7 rlung rta'i bsang bsdus pa 'di/ tshun bla ma yi dam mkha' 'grerdzo chos skyong dang / /'go ba'i lha lnga dgra lha gnyan po rnams/ /36

bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i phud kyis dgyes par bskang / /bdag gi rlung rta dar ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /'di skyabasarje bdud 'joms rin po che'i gsung in/ ༷/ ༷ ༷ ༷7/ dkar gsur bsdusapa 'di/ re yo kho gis bsang / 61 zhi/ཿrū gisabyin gyisabarlabs sbe/ gsur mchod 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'di/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum sri zhu'i mgron la 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /dam can chos skyong yon tan mgron la 'bul/ /mnyes shing tshims nas phyi nang bar chad 31la/ /rigs drug sems can snying rje'i mgron la bsngo/ /sdug bsngal kun bral zag med bde thobe 3rteg /gdon bgegs lha 'dre lan chags mgron la bsngo/ /gnod 'tshe'i sems zhi phan bdes 'tsho bar shog /'khor 'das mgron rigs dmigs med zang thal ngang / /'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings klong 37

dza(la 31ga /'di skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che'i gsung in/7/ dmar gsur bsdus pa 'di/ blas āḥlha/ thog med ngar 'dzin bag chags kyis/ /dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i rang gzugs ni/ /rgyal 'gong dam sri mo 'dre sogs/ /sdom shor dam nyams gnod sems can/ /rtag tu gzhan la 'tshe byed cing / /rnam dkar bsgrub la bar du gcod/ /blo bsgyur 'khon 'thab phung sna 'dren/ /zas nor longs spyod dpal la brku/ /phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i sgab 'dre'i rigs/ /lan chags mdza(na gyur thams cad la/ tag cikhrag la se1gas mkho rgu'i rdzas/ /'dod rgur 'char ba'i dri bsur sprin/ /nam mkha' mdzod du spro sa byas te/ /pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med par baspyod/ /dga' mgu yi rangs tshims gyur nas/ /bu 'ordzon lan chags sha 'khon byang / /rgyud la byang chub 38

sems skyes te/ /thar pa'i bde ba thob gyur cig /bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /smerdzon lam skurmengs su 'bru/ba par 31ga /'di skyabasarje bdud 'groms rin po che'i gsung in/ bsang dang dkar gsur dang dmar gsur gsum cha ra'i mjug lu chos sbyin 'di/ lha/bka pa ciyang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgya sa bstan pa yin/ /bsngo ba 'di/ sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ /'grerdzo ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas cerdzog /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma grol ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas grerdzol gyur cig/ / /39
phun sum tshogs pa'i bzhugs gral gyi rim pa/4ga

7 phun sum tshogs pa'i bzhugs gral gyi go rim dang mchod pa'i skor 'byug lugs/she/gro ma la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgrerdzon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la mchod pa 'bul/ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ma'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog ster ba/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gis tshe rabs sngerdzon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma/ /sngerdzo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi dpa'/ /yum gyur āryal bsnams la maḥrdzod pa 'bul/ /42

zhal zas ro brgya ldan cing yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul ba'i 'grerdzo ba 'di dag kun/ /'gyor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /)dri bzang la/ rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro dang / /mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa pa/ /sna phu pa dang dpal ldan 'brug pa serdzogs/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la mchesnad pa 'a bul/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad rdzi /cod pan gcig pur gyur pa chos kyi rgyal/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i byed pa po/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /chos sku gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /longs 43

spyod rdzogs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la/ /mtshan dang dpe byad phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /yi dam lha tsho gas rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /re'i( gsol ja dang 'bras ser la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rlabs phreng dbus/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i 'dab stong rgyas pa la/ /phan bde'i dri bsung ci yang spro ba'i gnyen/ /ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yi bu bzhin skyodang bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chesnas skyedang srung ma rnams la mcho da pa 'bul/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag serdzogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad gdon 44

dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gaskusnal/ /4bo/chang mchod 'di/ bla'i zhi/ཿlha tshar gsum gyis byin rlabs/ mchod do/ phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'gyor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du /gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / dur khrod chen po 45

brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du — /dpal ma hā ka la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen po bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la serdzogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du /gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams 6) zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ 'di kun mkhyen padma dkar tsho gsung in/ /5ga) phyag 'gyed/ do ma pa ni la sogs pa shing gog dang / kha zas sna bcu gsum/ dgu/ bdun ga de cig yod rung mjug star ko gis bsdus te drangs pa'i yun lu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla 46

ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /7 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rlabs 'phreng dbus/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i 'dab stso(nga rgyas pa la/ /phan bde'i dri bsung ci yang spro ba'i gnyen/ /ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la gsermol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs 'joms shing / /brtse bas gzhan don yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /nus pas bdud dpung 'joms byed lha yi lha/ /ngag dbang rnam rgyas zhabs la gasku(la ba 'debs/ /khams gsum sems can 'khore ba las 〉rtol phyir/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog rab brnyes nas/ /phrin 47

las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes par gyur cig gu/ / 7 bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gserdzol ba 'debs/ /'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma dang 'bral bar med par byin gyis rlobs/ /lto sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ gabyang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsode nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par sgyusgog /tshar gsum btang /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems 48

can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /tshar sam btang / lto mcholus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gserdzol/ /mabode po 'dir ni gyon pa legs/ /bdag cag bserdzod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gserdzol/ /31 gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sad ka ra ma hā sad ka ra ma hā arnya pra titstsha swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kun gyis khrus 49

gsermel ltar/ /de bzhin dag pa lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni sku khrus gserdzol/ /blas gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pākru pra titstsha swā hā/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse cher/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyis na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /31 gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta padma kā ma la ye st+waṃ// //7 rje sa ma' padma dkar tsho skyes rabs lubastod pa khorang gis/ phun ༄/ma tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i rnam rol gyis/ /yid can kun la phan bde'i mchog sbyin mkhan/ /tshe dpag med pa'i sras kyi thu therdzo pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs la gserdzol ba 'debs/ tanambha la yi rgyal khab seng ge'i khrir/ /dpal ldan rgyud kyi rgyas 'grel byed pa por/ /zas gtsang sras kyi lung bstan pad dkar 'dzin/ /rigs ldan dbang po gnyis 50

par /bod 'bangs kun la thugs rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /thub pa'i ring lugs lha mis mchod pa'i sre la/ /dang por bstod pa'i bka' drin zla med pa/ /sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal por /zab resna lta bas zhi ba'i mtshor 'khrungs shing / /zab rgyas chos phung bye ba'i chu klung gis/ /gdong dmar can gyi nang gi gdung sel mkhan/ tanānta rakṣi ta la /phyi nang shes bya'i 'dzin ma ma lus par/ /mi brjed gzungs kyi 'khor lor legs sgyur bas/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /paṇa chen nā ro ta parasdu /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i/ 〉sti ri bor dag pa'i bsam gtan pa/ /rje btsun zla 'od gzhon nur /gangs ri'i mgul du rdo rje'i gdan bkod la/ /grub pa 51

sangs rgyas stong gi rnam rol ba/ /lus can dbyed kyi skal pa bzang mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug par5 /shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i snang ba rab 'byams rtser/ /byang chub spyod pa rgya mcho snyerdzon byed pa'i/ /snang ba rdul bral sems dparasdu /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgor sbas pa/ /kun dga' dpal 'dresar skal bzang gdul bya la/ /ci dgar 'gyed pa'i mtshungs med lo tsā ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dbang por — /lho phyogs nor 'dzin chos kyis skyong ba'i dbang / /ma smad grags pa'i gter gyur snyigs dus 'dir/ /yang dag lam gyi sa mkhan mchog gcig pu/ /grerdzong ma grub pa'i rje bor ne /'jam mgon zhabs zung nyin mo'i khu ba la/ /lan brgyar 'thungs pa'i padma dkar po'i 'phreng / /52

dregs ldan kun gyi ral pa'i rgyan gyur pa'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma mchog derasdu /sngon byon rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i gzhi/ /ma byon rgyal ba rnams kyi 'byung khungs ba/ /da lta'i skyob pa dag dang dbyer med pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /de ltar gserdzol ba btab pa'i mthu stosnabs kyis//bdag dang mtha' yas 'grerdzo ba ma lus pa/ /mgon khyod mnyes byas gang gi ring lugs kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du thob gyur cig /7 bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsengal ba 'debs/ /mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gaskurdzol ba 'debs/ /'phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gse1la ba 'debs/ /bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan pa 53

'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /chos rnga chen po sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid cerdzog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsnga'o/ / lto mjug sdud smon lam kun khyen padma dkar po gis/ bde ba/zhegs ྅rton pa'i bstan pa mchog gi mtsho/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i sprin 'phreng gis/ /bshad sgrub char gyis nyin bzhin rnam spel ba/ /yangs pa'i stso(5 khams thams cad gang gyur cig /sdom gsum nyin mo'i 'od dang rtag 54

'grogs shing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i dri bzang 'dzin pa'i dbyed/ /bstan 'dzin padmo'i gtso bo ci yang gis/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /rnyed dang bkur sti'i chu klung rnams 'bab cing / /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen skye ba'i gnas/ /chos 'khor gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal rgya mcheras/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /lto bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snroni lam grub pa'i rgyal yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yi/ /gdon dang nad dang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs/ /sems can yid mi bde ba'i nad rnams kun/ /'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /ji ltar gshed mas khrid pa'i bsad bya bzhin/ /skad cig gcig 55

la lus sems 'bral byed pa'i/ /srog 'phrog nad kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha nang tshud pa ltar/ /nad kyi ming tsam thos pas skrag byed pa'i/ /nyin gcig pa dang rtag pa'i rim sogs kyis/ /lus can kun la gnod par ma gyur cig /gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / /glo bur ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la serdzogs pa yis/ /lus can kun la 'tshe bar ma gyur cig /lus sems bde ba ma lus 'phrog byed pa'i/ /'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /ma lus zhi zhing mdangs stobs ldan gyur nas/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /bla ma dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /mkha' 'gro 56

chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs dang / /las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub sdi/ra cig /so lam 'di gdan lo' po dpal ldan sa7lu nad rims ma 'dral rnam pa sna chogs byung pa'i dus lu sngags 'on tshu gis mdos gtor dang sman sngagasasrung ba lasogagapa ga de mang mang bsgrubasarung ma phan par gdan sa stong ni lu thug pa'i skabs rje grub dku 'a po gis ma nagamakha'i skyabaga'agyo'atho maṇi gyangs smon lama'adi btab zer bka' gnangam bzhin du 'bad ba lasabarten nad rimasatshu ga ra rgyun chad song ni de gis sa skya nad grolama'i smon lam zer dar nug /7 bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam rnam dag 'grub par shog /7 bkra khi 'di/ rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro dang / /mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa pa/ /sna phu pa dang dpal ldan 'brug pa sku1gas/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos sku gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /57

longs spyod rdzogs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la/ /mtshan dang dpe byad phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang / /khyad par tha/ rgyan dben gnas su/ /dam tshig can rnams bsrung mdzad pa'i/ /mkha' 'grerdzo ma rnams kyi bkra shis sgordzog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan bsrung phyir/ /'jigs byed mi bzad drag po'i lus dang ldan/ /rngam pa'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i/ /mgon po bya rog mtshan gyi bkra shis sgordzog /sa bcu nyid la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yang / /gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i khro tshul gyis/ /bstan la snang ba'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod/ /ye shes mgon po'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /zab mo rgyud kyi srung ma ma mo 3/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 58

'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /de yi sku gsung thugs sprul pho nya ni/ /'gugs byed gsod byed gsum dang mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /gdong can brgyad dang sgo ma bzhi la sogs/ /las byed pho nya rnams kyi bkra shis cerdzog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis cerdzog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi daskusnas shing / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis 3(ga /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis 31ga /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis cerdzog /mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra 59

shis 3(ga /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis cerdzog /gnas 'dir nyin resna bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis cerdzog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang / /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin dpon slob bzhin du mthun pa yis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /tshure ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tuste tso thā ga to hya wa data/ te rdzas yo ༷ ro dngha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra maṇaḥswāhā/ 61 su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā// //60

ji snye/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bzhugs gral dang mchod pa'i skor gter gsar lugs/)gro ma la/ o āḥhū/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan cing yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul ba'i 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'gror ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /she/dri bzang la/ kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī seng / /padmā ka ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs gnyags gter stod brgya rtsa sogs/ /bka' gter bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /she)gsol ja 'bras ser la/ rgya gar paṇa chen stod la bka' drin che/ /padma 'byung gnas sku la 'das grerdzongs med/ /da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad/ /o rgyan rin po che la mchod pa 'bul/ /4)chang phud sapa/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ/ 31 āḥlha/ lan sam/ mchod 61

do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'gror rgyud/ rnal 'gror bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tsho gas rnams kyi zhal du sarba /ma gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'grerdzo ma rnams dang / gnas nyer bzhi/ yul so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'grerdzo ma rnams kyi zhal du sarba 5 /dpal ma hā ka la khrag 'thung gi rgyal perdzo/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rnal 'gror yongs kyi dgra lha/ bdud dpung sgrol ba'i 62

dpa' bo/ bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po/ legs ldan rdo rje srin po tshogs kyi bdag po sogs dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sngerdzod dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du sarbapa /gzhan yang sman ljongs lho'i rgyal khams 'di nyid du dkar phyogs skyong zhing / nag phyogs srung bar byed pa'i gnas bdag /gter bdag /gzhi bdag /11nga bdag rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa yi/ /chos srung yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag bsam don ma lus grub par ma1rdod/ /kun mkhyen pad dkar gsung las kha bsgyurawa in/re'i/phyag 'gyedapa/ do ma pa ni/ shing thog /dgun chag /ngang lha la sogs pa sna khag bcu gsum/ dgu/ bdun ga de cig yod rung mjug star ko gis bsdu ste drangs pa'i yun lu/63 ༄

ra༅༅/ /'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di/lā dang bya ba ga ci 'bad ni sbe spar bcam pa'i skabs he ma rang 'di tshar gcig btang pa cin 〉ba ngo bde ba lu mno don bzhin du 'bad tshugs ga de 'bad rung sems khar bzhag /31/ snang srid rnam dag rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i/ /bkra shis phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i chogs/ /kun la phyag 'tshal bdag cag bkra shis shog /sgron me'i rgyal po rtsal brtan don grub dgongs/ /byams pa'i rgyan dpal dge grags dpal dam pa/ /kun la dbordzongs pa rgya cher grags pa can/ /lhun nge ltar 'phags rtsal grags dpal dang ni/ /sems can thams cad la dadurdzongs grags pa'i dpal/ /yid tshim mdzad pa rtsal rab grags dpal te/ /mtshan tsam thos pas bkra shis dpal 'phel ba/ /bde bar btanags pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'o(/ /'jam dpal 64

gzhon nu dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgos po byams pa'i dpal/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'phags mchog kun tu bzang / /ātpal rdo rje pad dkar klu shing dang / /nor bu zla ba ral gri nyi ma yi/ /phyag mtshan legs bsnams bkra shis dpal gyi mchormeg /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'o// /rin chen gdugs mchog bkra shis gser gyi nya/ /'dod 'byung bum bzang yid 'ong ka ma la/ /snyan grags dung dang phun tshogs dpal be'u/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan dbang bsgyur 'kherdzor 'ordzo ste/ /rin chen rtags mchog brgyad kyi phyag mtshan can/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes bskyed ma/ /sgeg sogs ngo bo dran pas dpal spel ba'i/ /bkra shis lha re brgyad la phyag 65

'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa chen po bde 'byung sred med bu/ / mig stong ldan dang rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /'phags skyes po dang klu dbang mig mi bzang / /rnam thos sras te lha rdzas 'khor lo dang / /tri shu la dang mdung thung rdo rje can/ /pi waṃ ral gri mchod rten rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sa gsum gnas su dge legs bkra shis spel/ /'jig rten skyedang ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'o(/ /bdag cag deng 'dir bya ba :snam pa la/ /gegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ /'dod don dpal 'phel bsam don yid bzhin 'grub/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tsho gas par 31ga /yar longam da thun btang pa bi de tshes snyam gyi don dag gar 'grub 'ong / yi ba'i bsgang btang pa cin rmi lam bzang po mthong 'ong / dmag rgyab par 'gro ba'i bsgang btang pa cin rang rgyal kha thob/ lā dang bya ba 'go btsug pa'i bsgang btang pa cin 'dod pa'i don de tshu 'gyel 'ong / rtagabu ra thun btang pa cin tshe dang dpal 'byor gtapa snyan grags rgyu nor gyi 'byor pa tshu bkra shis bde legs phun gsum tshogs te bsam don tshu sems kyis mno don bzhin 66

'grub 'ong / sdig pa dang bsgrib pa ga ra phar byang ste gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang mthar thug nges par legs pa'i don de tshu cha mnyam rang 'grub 'ong zer rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gis gsungs nug /me sprel zla7 5pa'i tshes ragaza' nyim dang rgyu skar rgyal gyi dus tshes bzang po'i cha lu 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje yid mcho las thon pa'i nor bu'i do shal in/7 'grug rgyal khab bde tog to 'ong ni'i smon lam don gnyis bsam pa myur 'grub ma zer mi 'di in/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum skyabs kun 'dus pa'i sku/ /snang srid zil gnon o rgyan rin po che/ /gsol 'debs bu la thugs rjes brtser dbo ngas nas/ /bsam don myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs dus rang rtags mi thub lnga bdo zhing / khaṃ rnams shes rgyud bsam sbyodar 'ordzog pa'i mthus/ /bsesad nams ྅rtobs zad las ngan mtsho chen balngosal/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag 'di las da skyobs shig /lho ljongs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /btsa' sad thog ser shwa lud chu 'o(ga dang / /sa g.yos ri nyil rlung than me dgra sogs/ /snod 67

kyi nyes tshogs zhi bar byinarji mi phyugs nad yams 'go ba'i nad kyi rigs/ /za 'dre shi gshed gson 'dre 'byung pos 'tshe/ /dus min 'chi rkyen glo bur than ltas sogs/ /bcud kyi nyes tshogs zhi bar /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /tshe ring nad med 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel/ /dbul phongs 'thab rtsod ming yang mi grags par/ /bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho bar ne /khyad par dus ngan yo lang rtsub 'gyur 'phrul/ /rgya 'dre dam sri 'gong po'i gnod gdug dbal/ /mtha' dmag kla klo'i rgelo ngan 'khrugs rtsod dpung / /phyir zlog rtsad nas chod par /mi dang mi min lha 'dre su yang rung / /nag phyogs dpung nyams dkar phyogs dbu 'phang mtho/ /chos ldan rgyal srid mnga' thang mtha' nas rgyas/ /dredags las rnam par rgyal 68

bar — /rgyal bstan mdo sngags chos tshul yid bzhin nor/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor rtag 'god pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bas / phan bde'i 'dod rgu 'jo bar /mdor na bdag sogs khyed kyi gdul bya rnams/ /las rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi btang bar/ /nam yang mi 'bral brtse bas rjes ba zung nas/ /don gnyis bsam pa lhun grub bkra shis stsol/ /smo lam 'di yang mkhyen pa dang rtogs pa'i thugs rje can gyi bdag nyid slob dpon bsod nams bzang po gis bkra shis pa'i kha dar nyin mo bde legs dang bcas pa'i sgo las gsung gis bskul ma nan bskyar gnangam bzhin du shes rgyan bla ma dgyes pa'i bka' 'bangs 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rje gis gnam lo lcags khyi sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes 15'i dus chen gyi nyi mar bris te gnang gnangam 6)na pas/ /7 na mo gurushā gnam lo sprel lo sprel zla ra ba'i tshes bcu tham lu bsam yas bar khang g.yu zhal ༅ lu rdo rje dbyengs kyi dkyil gsor zhal phyes gnang pa'i bsgang 6rdzo rgyan gu ru rin po che gis smon lam 'di gsungs gnangam las rje 'bangs ga ra gis thugs dam rgyun ma chad par mdzad nug /phyi rabs zer ma 'ongs pa'i rjes 'jug tshu gis 'di lu thugs dam rtse gcigakhar bkal te gnang dgos zer bskul ma mdzad nug: dresags bcu dus bzhi'i 69

rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: ma lus zhing gi rdul snyed gshegs su gsol: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mar: rte na mchog bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga ru: sngon gyi sdig pa'i tshogs la bdag gnong zhing : da lta'i mi dge 'asno pas rab tu bshags: phyin chad de las ldog phyir bdag gis bsdam: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la yi rang ngo : rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bar: sde snod gsum dang bla med chos 'khor bskor: dge tshogs ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud la bstso1 'gro rnams bla med thar pa'i sar phyin 31ga: sangs rgyas sras bcas bdag la 70

dgongs su gsol: bdag gis brtsams pa'i spyod lam rab bzang 'di: rgyal ba kun tu bzang dang de sras dang : 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mkhyen pa ltar: de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob shog: bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma rin chen rnams: nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par 3(ga: nyi zla bzhin du kun la gsal bar shog: ri bo bzhin du rtag tu brtan par shog: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun rin po che: thugs mthun khrims gtsang bslab gsum gyis phyug 〈snag: bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags sgrub pa'i sde: dam tshig ldan zhing bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin 31ga: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos skyodang rgyal po yang : chab srid rgyas shing bstan la sman par shog: bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs rgyal rigs blersha yo 77

yang : blo gros rab 'phel rtsal dang ldan par shog: bstan pa'i gsos byed khyim bdag 'gror ldan rnams: longs spyod ldan zhing nyer 'tshe med par /rtog: bstan la dad pa'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun: bde skyid ldan zhing bar chad zhi bar shog: lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyang : dam tshig mi nyams bsam pa 'grub par 31ga: bdag la bzang ngan las kyis 'brel gyur gang : gnas skabs mthar thug rgyal bas rjes 'dzin shog: 'gro rnams bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: kun bzang rgyal srid chen po thob par 31ga: de bzum ma'i so lam i mar dusadrugalu ga' dgos/ sa ma yorgya: lhasrasamurugakyisprulapa gter chenamachogagyur gling pa gis gnasamachogaseng chen gnamabragagi g.yas zur brag ri rin po che brtsegasapa'i gong mo 'og ma las khrom gter sbe spyan drangasapa'i bai ro'i sku chosadar shog gi logasalu ye shesamacho rgyal gyi phyag bris bod yig bzhur ma zer mi las padma gan dbang blo gros mtha' yasakyisadag par dpe bzhuloganang gnangam in72

pas/ /༈ snga 'gyur bstan pargyas pa'i smon lam chosakyi rgyal po thugs dgyes pa'i zhal lung zer mi de dusakyi tha ma lu rtsagasum ltayi thugayokyirgyud bskulate gis bstan pa'i snying po rin po che 'di dar zhing rgyas par gyur cigamano ba'i bsam pa' tshogade cig btang rung yang bsod namasatshad medapacig ldan pa'i khar / rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs gamathar phyin bzhinam las skyeb rtagagarang rgyalagardzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyichos dang dam pa'i chos kyi snying po sa mo'i theg gdang 'phyad zhinam laga'aphral mgyogasarnamapa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes lu reg par 'gyur ni'i dgos g.yodapalas/ skalab dang ldan pa'i mi tshu gis dus dang dugasu dang khyad par du tshogs mang gi skabasalu smon lama'adi bzugabakha dgos/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas/ /khyad par mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / /rgyal sras brgyad dang gnas brtan 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /phan bde'i 'gyung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /stoni dang sems dpa' 'phags pa mchog rnams kyis/ /yang yang dka' bas btsal zhing brnag pa'i don/ /mcho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /73

mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i 'ordzo paṇa dang / /bka' gter rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi dam lha/ /ma mabesgon gza' rdor rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs/ /snga 'gyur rtsa gsum lha chogs dgongs su gsol/ /thub bstan mdo dang sngags kyi tshul mtha' dag /gangs can ljongs su brtse bas drangs gyur pa/ /ches cher spel ba'i rdo rje'i dam dgongs nas/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i /phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /rigs gsum sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul rol mo yis/ /gangs can phan bde'i nyi ma gsal bar mdzad/ /mtshor skyesapa /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa chen po'i tshorags/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar nyer bzung nas/ /dri med rgyal bstan nor bu'i rgyal mtshan sgreng / /mcho skyes — /thun mong thun min 74

gzhung kun rang dbang gis/ /ma nor bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa yis/ /gangs ljongs snang ba'i sgo chen thog mar phyes/ /mcho skyes /skal bzang gdul byas mdo dang sngags kyi tshul/ /nyams su len la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /bka' dang dgerdzongs pa 'grel ba'i gzhung kun rdzogs/ /mtsho skyesasdu /bden gsung bka' yi rgya mcho chen po la/ /zab mo'i chos gter nor bus mngon par mdzes/ /mdo dang sngags kyi lam bzang zung du 'brel/ /mtsho skyes /med byung za hor mkhan po'i spyod pa dang / /mtshungs med dpal ldan klu yi lta ba gnyis/ /zung 'brel brgyud pa'i bka' sretrel phyag rgyas btab/ /mtsho skyes /zab mo'i nang rgyud sde gsum dgongs pa'i bcud/ /thun min man ngag gsang ba'i lam mchormeg nas/ /'ja' 'u/sa 75

chotshes skur gshegs pa'i cad mtshar 'bar/ /mtshor skyes /rab 'byams zhi khre'i khyab bdag sgrub sde brgyad/ /bka' bab rig 'dzin so so'i dgongs bcud dang / /kun 'dus padma'i bka' srol gcig tu 'khyil/ /mtsho skyes /rgyu dang 'bras bu gsang sngags theg pa che/ /tshang la ma cesar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lung / /ḍā zhi'i zhal gyi drod rlangs tho le ba/ /mtsho skyesapa /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs rpā bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i rang bzos ma bslad pa/ /mtsho skyesasdu /gser zhing nor bu'i spras pa'i yon gyis kyang / /mi 'tshigs dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs mdzod chos/ /brtse bas rjes 'jug skal pa kho nar bkram/ /mtsho skyesaḥ /ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i ye shes la/ /rang bzhin 76

lhun gyis grub pa'i gdangs shar bas/ /blun sgom sems las 'das pa'i rdzogs pa che/ /mtsho skyes 5 /yod med phyogs rer zhen pa'i dmigs gtad zhig /mthar 'dzin lta ba'i 'dzin stangs drung nas phyung / /gzhi lam 'bras bu snang stong zung du 'jug /mtsho skyes /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug don/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rig stong mi shigs rdo rje grub pa'i mtha'/ /mtsho skyes 0 /mang du thos pa lung gi sprin 'khrigs shing / /pha rol rgelo 'joms rig pa'i glog phreng 'bar/ /man ngag gnad kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim mtsho skyes /rmyad byung a ti yo ga'i gseng lam nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /khyab bdag 'jam dpal rdo rje rab bsgrubs pa/ /mtsho skyes /yang dag tshad 77

ma gsum gyi nga ro yis/ /lta dman ri dwags tshogs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /theg mchog seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum khyab/ /mtshopa skyes: /rgyal bstan martongs su rdzogs pa'i gos bzang rtser/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i tog mdzes pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mtho/ /mtsho skyes: /bdag sogs deng nas 'gro ba ji srid du/ /ba stan dang bstan pa'i snying po yolkong sa rdzogs pa/ /mkha' khyab zhing du 'odzin skyong spel ba yis/ /mcho skyesaḥ /mdor na mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar gyis/ /spyos bstan spel ba'i phrin las mkha' khyab pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin dam pas sa stong 81ngas gang nas/ /mtsho skyesasdu /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ /chos srid mi 78

nub nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /'di yo ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasakyi ngo so dpalaldan sangs rgyas padma skyes zer ddha na ko sha'i rgya mtsho'i me tog padma'i sdong po lasa'agrungasami 'chi med rdo rje sku mchog gu ru rin po che gi bstan pa snga 'gyur rnying ma zer slab mi 'di ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogasapa'i rtsa ba yinam las zab pa'i gnad che ba le shā cig dang ldan pa'i khyad chos dang / ltab dang sgom pa rnam par dgapa rgyalagathugasadagyegapa'i lam bzang ma noralho.inam 'di ngo shes bzhinam las nor bu rin po che phyags te rgyal mtshan gyi 'gu lu mchodapa bzhin du mi skal ba dang ldan mi tshu gis 'chad mmu rtsom gsumagyibya ba rlabasa' 'di phyogayog te lu yang dar zhing rgyas par mdzad ni'i thugasakhur bzhesabazhesapa dang de bzugama'i thugayobazhed 'di bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrub ni'i rten 'brel gyi smon tshig lu rnying ma'i bstan pa lu lhagabasam rnam par dkar ba ldan mi mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho gis gnas dang dusaphun sum tshogos pa'i rten 'brel bzang po'i gung thun lu shar mar bris gnang gnangam in pas/ /lto 'a〈sna ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te ༷/na ring gnas gyur cig /ces dang / gtsug lag khang rnams 〉rtog pa dang / /kha tone gyis rgyas legs gnas shing / /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa 79

dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /'di zhi ba lha'i gsung in/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam 'grub par 3(ga/ //7 bkra shis 'di/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tuste shtsa thā ga to hya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dngha e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇa swā hā/ phun sum chogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab gaskusna med pa/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi 80

dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis 3rdzog /dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing / /dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis shog /7/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis 3snag /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs dug lnga gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis 6rtog /dge 'dun yoni tan rin 84

chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyas sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /lto sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs 3snag /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs sgo(ga /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /chogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /82

dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs cesag /'di sangs rgyas kyisagasungs gnang gnangam in/ pho bla : phun sum tshogs pa bla med dkon mchog gsum: bkra shis kun gyi 'byung gnas bkra shis pa: grags pa'i bkra shis 'jig rten yongs la khyab: dge legs phun sum chesnags pa'i bkra shis shog: lha ra ṇa sī nyams dga' bde skyid ldan: yul phyogs 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis sgordzog: grong khyer ser skya dpal dang yon tan rgyas: grong brdal 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis phre(ga: lhas bstan khab tu chos dang 'gyor pas gang : khang khyim 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis sgordzog: rgyal po zas gtsang 'khor 'ordzos sgyur ba'i rigs: skyes pa 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis 83

shog: btsun mo sgyu 'phrul rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: bud med 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis cerdzog: rgyal bu don grub legs pa'i dpal kun 'byor: lha sras 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis 〈snag: sa 'tsho grags 'dzin yone tan dam pas brgyan: btsun rere 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis sho(ga: zheng shes bsngags ldan sprin gyi dza/gas chen 'chang : rta mchodag 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis shog: ni rañdza na me tog 'bras bus brgyan: skyed tshal 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis 31ga: yangs pa can du 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel: sa phyogs 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis 6rdzog: rdo rje gdan du thub pa mngon sangs rgyas: gnas rten 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis shog: bya rgod spungs rir zug chen chos 'khor 84

bskor: chos ra 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis cerdzog: rgyal byed tshal du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'du: dgon sde 'dir yang de bzhin bkra shis shog: nyin mo bkra shis bde ba'i nyi ma shar: mtshan mo bkra shis skyid pa'i zla ba gsal: nyin mtshan bkra shis bde skyid phywa g.yang 'phel: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra 43sa 31ga: 'di gu ru chos dbang rin po che'i zab gter las bton tonem 6)na/ /lto rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs: yi dam mkha' 'grerdzo lus dang grib bzhin 'dzasnags: chos skyedang srung mas bar chad kun bsal nas: mcho ga thun dngos grub 'grub pa'i bkra shis sgormeg: mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa dredags bcur rgyas: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad phrin 'phel: 'jig rten khams kun 85

nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi: rtag tu bde skyid dpal gnas bkra shis 31ga: 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan thams cad 'bral med par: srid dang zhi ba'i dpal la longs spyod cing : sku tshe yar tsho zla ba ji bzhin 'phel: snyan grags mkha' mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis 3rteg: lha rnams mkha' las me tog char chen 'bebs: klu rnams kun gyis sa gzhi 'gror pas bkang : bar du skye rgu thams cad bde dang ldan: mthar thug mngon sangs rgyas pa'i bkra phogs/ 31ba/: 'di mchog gling gter kha las bton tonam in/7/ rgyal ba sras bcas bserdzod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang / /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo 86

bzhin du brtan pa dang / /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang / /snyan grags nam mkha' bzhin du khra/ba pa ste/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stostong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /bzhi po des kyang /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum 〉pogs/ /theg pa mchormog la nges par 'byung ba ste/ /lnga po des kyang /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa ste/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lto/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i 87

gung yang brda logs sheng / /nyan mtshan rtas tu bad legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ /dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir sdo(la/ /yi dam lha yis deng 'dir stsol/ /chos skyong srung mas deng 'dir stsol/ /gzhi bdag rnams kyis deng 'dir ྅(la/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ khen tu bden par gsungs shing rdzun med pa/ /bden pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs serdzog /deng kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /deng 'dir rnal 'gror pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchesgod 'kherdzor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba 88

gza' sgra gcan gyi gnod pa las grol ba bzhin du bdud dang spang bya bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //89
smon lam phyogs bsdus/ 91

༄༄/ /mar me smon lam lu/ dmigs rim bskyed thang 'di/ mar me'i hesad ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor yug dang mnyam par gyur cig /grangs ni sangs rgyas re re'i mdun du re re gsal bar gyur cig /'od kyis srid pa'i rtse mo man chad dang mnar med pa'i dmyal khams yan chad 6) ma rig pa'i na/na pa thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i zhing khams mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig /6rdzo badzra ā lo ke āḥlha/ oṃ āḥlha/ yid 'ong dbyebs mdzes rin chen kong bu ru/ /gtsang sbyar rtsi bcud mar khus legs gtams shing / /drangs 'jam lha rdzas sdong bur yongs spar ba'i/ /mun sel snang gsal 〉tren me'i mchod pa 'di/ /khyab bdag bla ma mchormog gsum rtsa ba gasnge/ma/ /92

rab 'byams skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshochogs la 'bul/ /ye shes spyan la gsal sgrib mi mnga' yang / /bdag serdzogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /ma rig sgrib gnyis mun pa rab bsal nas/ /yang dag shes rab mchog gi mig thob 31ga /skyabs rje bdud yoms 'jis bral ye shes rdo rje'i gsung in/7/ 'grug rgyal khab 'di bde tog to 'ong ni'i smon lam don gnyis bsam pa myur 'grub ma zer mi 'di in/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum skyabs kun 'dus pa'i sku/ /snang srid zil gnon o rgyan rin yo che/ /gsol 'debs bu la thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas/ /bsam don myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs dus rang rtags mi thub lnga bdo zhing / /mi rnams shes rgyud bsam sbyor log pa'i mthus/ /bsod nams stobs zad las ngan mtshor chen brdol/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag 'di 93

las da skyobs shig /lho ljongs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /btsa' sad thog ser shwa zhud chu 'o(ga dang / /sa g.yos ri nyil rlung than me dgra sogs/ /snod kyi nyes tshogs zhi bar byin5 /mi phyugs nad yams 'go ba'i nad kyi rigs/ /za 'dre shi gshed gson 'dre 'byung pos 'tshe/ /dus min 'chi rkyen glo bur than ltas sogs/ /bcud kyi nyes tshogs zhi bar5 /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /tshe ring nad med 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel/ /dbul phongs 'thab rtsod ming yang mi grags par/ /bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho b.rarwa /khyad par dus ngan mtshe lang rtsub 'gyur 'phrul/ /rgya 'dre dam sri 'gong po'i gnod gdug dbal/ /mtha' dmag kla klo'i rgole ngan 'khrugs rtsod dpung / /phyir zlog rtsad nas chod par rtsa /mi 94

dang mi min lha 'dre su yang rung / /nag phyogs dpung nyams dkar phyogs dbu 'phang mtho/ /chos ldan rgyal srid mnga' thang mtha' nas rgyas/ /phyogs la sa rnam par stso(5 bar /rgyal bstan mdo sngags ཿtshes tshul yid bzhin nor/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor rtag 'gode pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bas/ /phan bde'i 'dod rgu 'jo bar — /mdor na bdag sogs khyed kyi gdul bya rnams/ /las rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi btang bar/ /nam yang mi 'bral brtse bas rjes bzung nas/ /don gnyis bsam pa lhun grub bkra shis stsol/ /smolam 'di yang mkhyen pa dang rtogs pa'i thugs rje can gyi bdag nyid slob da' bsod nams bzang po gis bkra shis pa'i kha dar nyin mo bde legasadang bcigapa'i sgo lag gsung gisabaskulaganan bskyar gnangamabazhinadu o rgyan bla ma dgyesapa'i bka' 'bangs tshogs bralaye shes rdo rje gis gnam lo lcags ji sa gazla ba'i yar tshes15'i dus chen gyi nyi mar bris te gnang nug/ ma las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yi/ /95

gdon dang nad dang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs/ /sems can yid mi bde ba'i nad rnams kun/ /'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /ji ltar gshed mas khrid pa'ibasad bya bzhin/ /skad cig gcig la lus sems 'bral byed pa'i/ /srog 'phrog nad kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha nang tshud pa ltar/ /nad kyi ming tsam thos pas skrag byed pa'i/ /nyin gcig pa dang rtag pa'i rim sogs kyis/ /lus can kun la gnod par ma gyur cig /gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / /glo bur ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la serdzogs pa yis/ /lus can kun la 'tshe bar ma gyur cig /lus sems bde ba ma lus 'phrog byed pa'i/ /96

'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /ma lus zhi zhing mdangs stobes ldan gyur nas/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /bla ma dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs dang / /las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobes kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub gyur cig /rsā lam 'di gdan sa chen po dpal ldan gaskya lu nad rims ma 'dral rnamapa sna tshogasabyung ba'i dus lu sngagasarsā tshu gis mdogagator dang sman sngagayosrung ba lasogasapa ga de mang mang bsgrubasarung maphan par gdan sa stong ni lu thug pa'i skabs rje grub thob chen po gis ma nam mkha'i skyabasa'agro'adon ma ṇi gyangs smone lam 'di btab zer bka' gnangam bzhin du 'bad ba lasabarten nad rimasatshu gar rgyunachad song ni de gis saskya nad grol ma'i smon lam zer dar nug /me dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur ni'i legasasmon tshes pa'i zla ba zer mi 'di en/ bslu med dkon mchog rin chen rtsa ba gsum/ /khyad par bstan srung ma hā kā la'i tshogs/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi smon lam 'di/ /gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzod/ /97

phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub bstan nor 'dzin spyi dang khyad par du/ /sman ljongs sa yi thig ler khyab pa yi/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /rgyal ba'i lung bstan dwags po bka' brgyud kyi/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs ring lugs snying po'i bcud/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i bka' babs nyid gyur pa/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /spyan ras gzigs dbang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yi/ /snying po'i bstan pa gsal bar zhal 'che bzhin/ /sprul pa'i gdung 'dzin nor bu'i phreng chogs kyis/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'ipa /mkhas grub rin chen 'byung gnas rgya mtsho che/ /mdo sngags chos kyi chu klung kun 'dus shing / /bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rlabs chen gyis/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /sde snedi srog shing 98

rgyud sde nor bu'i tog /sgra tshad rig pa'i gos bzang sham bu can/ /sku(ngas rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mkha' la bsgreng / /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /thos bsam rgya mtsho 'i ska rags can bskor zhing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sna zhags ring du bskyod/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i khog lag yerdzongs su rdzogs/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /mkhas grub bye ba'i ral klung nas drangs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs don bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rtog ge'i dug chu'i rang bzos ma rnyog par/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang gis rgyud sbyangs shing / /chig chog gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i doni/ /nyams bzhes bstar la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /dpal ldan 'byug pa'i /rtogs pa don gyi man ngag la brten nas/ /lhan 99

cig skyes sbyor zab mo'i nyams len gyis/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi rtogs pa tshad du phyin/ /dpal ldan 'drug pa'iju /gdams ngag stsokhong po gsum 'dril khang bzang du/ /sems kyi rdo rjer rtsen pa'i zla bzhin mas/ /gzhan sde'i brtan pa 'phromag pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'ipa /lta bas shes bya'i de nyid rtogs pas mkhas/ / sgom pas nyone mongs rang zhir song bas btsun/ /spyode pas rang done yid byed zad pas bzang / /dpal ldan 'drug pa'i5 /phyi ltar bslab gsum gtsang ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nang ltar rim gnyis zab glerdzos thugs rgyud smin/ /gsang ba rang bzhin shes pa'i gnad kyis grol/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'irwa /mthu chen bla ma'i bka' khrims lugs gnyis kyi/ /bsnyo1ga rlabs 'bar bas tshul min 100

mthar byed pa'i/ /bstan bsrung mkha' lding nag po'i drag dza/la gyis/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /bsngags chosgos yoni tan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /snyan grags skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dgrangs kyis/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho mgrone khug ste/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /thugs mthun khrims gtsang 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i 'jing / /gsum ldan nor bu'i klu dbang ji snyed kyis/ /bsnyen bkur gdengs ma'i rtse mor rtag mchod nas/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i pa /lhag bsam nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba yis/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i dri bsung gis/ /blo gsal sbrang rtsir spyodad pa'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'ipa / klog spong 'dab zung rgyas pa'i rol rtsed kyi/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i bla na zhing bzhin du/ /bstan 'dzin bung bas sa 40

chen kun khyab ste/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /bstan pa rin chen mchog ltar snang ba'i mthus/ /nad mug 'khrugs rtsod smag rum kun zhi nas/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /chos kyi rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yi/ /mi dbang chab srid mnga' thang dgung du 'phyur/ /'bangs rnams bde skyid dpal la 'ordzongs spyodad nas/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang / /chos can chos nyid zab mo'i bden stobs dang / /bdag gzhan lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /rsā lama'adi yang sangasagyogakyi bstan pa nyim nub kha'i grib so bzum thug pa'i dus lu bstan pa'i cha rkyen lu dmigs te shākya'i dge slong dge 'dun rin chen gyisabartsams gnang nug /tsa/ na mo gu 0 gnam lo sprel 4 sprelazla ra ba'i tsheg75bsagayags khang g.yuzhalacanalu rdo rje khungasakyiputrelpoge'i zhalaphyeloganang pa'i bsgang o yo guru rin po che gis102

smon lam 'di gsungs gnangam las rje 'bangasag ra gis thugs dgargyun ma chad par mdzad nug/ phyi rabs zer ma'ongasapa'i rjesa'ajug tshu gis 'di lu thugasadam rtse gcig khar ba/gote gnang dgos zer bskul ma mdzad nug /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyas ba sras dang bcas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong chogs: ma lus zhing gi rdul snyed gshegs su gsol: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal wo phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: rten mchog bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga ru: sngon gyi sdig pa'i tshogs la bdag gnong zhing : da lta'i mi dge 'gyod pas rab tu bshags: phyin chad de las ldog phyir bdag gis bsdam: bsode nams dge chogs kun la yi rang ngo : rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bar: sde rsā gsum dang bla med chos 'kho bskor: dge chogs ga 03

ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud la bsngoX 'gro rnams bla med thar pa'i sar phyin the(ga: sangs rgyas sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis brtsams pa'i rnyed lam rab bzang 'di: dzormel ba na/na tu bzang dang de sras dang : 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mkhyen pa ltar: de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob snartog: bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma rin chen rnams: nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par 31ga: nyi zla bzhin du kun la gsal bar shog: ri bo bzhin du rtag tu brtan par shog: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun rin po che: thugs mthun khrims gtsang bslab gsum gyis phyug 31ga: bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags sgrub pa'i sde: dam tshig ldan zhing bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin shog: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos skyong 104

rgyal po yang : chab srid rgyas shing bstan la sman par /rtog: bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs rgyal rigs blon po yang : blerdzo pyodas rab 'phel rtsal dang ldan par 3(ga: bstan pa'i gasku(sa byed khyim bdag 'dre(ra ldan rnams: 'odangs spyod ldan zhing nyer 'tshe med par ce(ga: bstan la dad pa'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun: bde da ldan zhing bar chad zhi bar shog: lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyang : dam tshig mi nyam/sa bsam pa 'grub par 31ga: bdag la bzang ngan las kyis 'brel smyur gang : gnas skabs mthar thug rgyal bas rjes 'dzin snartog: 'gro rnams bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: kun bzang rgyal srid chen po thob par shog: de bzum ma'i smo lam smi ma' dus drugalu yon dgos/ sa ma ya rgya: ltasrasapurugakyisprul lha gto rsā mchonagyur gling pa gis gnasamachonaseng wo gnagabrag405

gi g.yas zur bragari rin po che bugasapa'i gong mo 'ogam las khrom gter spe a drangasapa'i rlu tsho sku chosadar shogagi logasalu ye shesamacho rgyal gyi phyagabris 'od yig bzhur ma zer mi las padma gan dbang blogros 4'a yasakyisadag par dpe bshugaganang gnangam inapas// //snye dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ /chos srid mi nub nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / 7 zangs mdog dpal ri lu bkod pa'i smon lam skal bzang dga' ba'i shing rta 'di/ rang snang dag pa bde chen rdo rje'i stongs/ /lhun grub 'og min sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i phul/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /yid 'ong padma rā ga'i ri dbang rtser/ /106

nor bu'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i pho brang ni/ /phul byung ngo mtshar bkod pas mdzes pa can/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /tsandan nags tshal dkrig pa'i do ra ru/ /g.yu yi spangs ljongs sna tshogs chu skyes bzhin/ /ge sar 'dzum mdangs dgod pa'i lang tsho ngoms zangs mdog dpal gyi ri sor skye bar shog /ga bur spos chus gsher ba'i bdud rtsi'i klung / /lhung lhung nyams dgar 'bab cing 'khor ba'i rdzing / /gzhon nu'i gar mkhan ci yang rtse zhing rgyu/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar che(ga /dbang gzhu'i sdo/ra khyim 'khrigs pa'i drwa mig nas/ /me rkelteg char zim 'bab pa'i rdul phreng dang / /ging chen bde ba'i gar gyis rnam par rtse/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar 3snag /phun tshogs 'dod pa'i yoni tan 107

rnam mang pos/ /kun nas mdzes rgur brgyan byas mkha' 'gro'i sprin/ /mi 'dzad phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i blar bres pa/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi gral dbus na/ /padma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i dbang po yis/ /zab gsang seng ge'i sgra chen kun tu smrogs/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar sgordzog /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nga yin zhes/ /mkhyen brtse'i ye shes mtshungs pa med pa'i stosnabs/ /mu med gdul bya'i khams dang mnyam par 'jug /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /yod tan rgya mtsho pha mtha' yas pa'i gter/ /dran pa tsam gyis zhing der dbugs 'byen pa'i/ /ngo mtshar phrin las 'khor lo'i gzi byin can/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar 3(ga /108

mkha' spyod padma 'od mdzes grong khyer du/ /da lta nyid du btsan thabs bgrod nas kyang / /don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub pa'i rnam thar tshul/ /mnyam med gu ru khyod dang mtshungs par se(ga /rsā lam 'di yang skyabs rje kho ra'i sras mo bde skyong ye shes dbang mo de padma 'od lu bkod pa'i cha rkyen lu dmigs te pha rgan 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rje gis thugs gding las skyo ba'i gdung zhugs kyis smon lam 'di btab gnang gnangam in pas/lto bde ldan zhing du snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur/ /ri bo ta lar 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /rnga yab gling du padma krerdzod phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma rje/ /snying nas mos gdung drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /rtag tu brtse bas rjes bzung byin rlabs ྅rtol / /gnas skabs phyi nang 'gal spre)na bar chad zhi/ /tshe ring bde 'byor bsam done lhun gyis 'grub/ /chos min lta ngan 409

rgyud la mi skye bar/ /chos mthun dkar po'i bsam sbyor gong du 'phel/ /nam zhig 'chi kha gnad gcod mi myong zhing / /'phos ma thag tu mkha' 'grerdzos mdun bsus nas/ /padma 'od kyi zhing du skyes nas kyang / /gu ru'i zhal mthong gsung gi lung nod de/ /sa lam yon tan mig 'phrul lta bur bgrod/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mtha' ru phyin par 31ga /smon lam 'di dad pa ༅ tshu lu chos kyi 'brel pa bzhag gnang ni'i don lu logs bral ye shegardo rje gis gsungasaganang nug /tsha bsode nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas shing / /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sngerdzol bar 3(ga /skyesarabs nang las in/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsede nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis ga 0

thobe par thegag /dpal mtsho 'phagasapa klu sgrub kyi gsung in/7 rin chen dge tshogs 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /rtag tu dam pa'i chos dang mi 'bral zhing / /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa mthar phyin nas/ /chos rnga sgrogs pas 'jig rten mdzes par sge ga /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cig /tshe rabs kun tu chos la spyod gyur cis /rgyal khams kun tu bkra shis rgyas gyur cig /'grerdzo kun phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /chos tshul 'di yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu grags gyur te/ /blo gros padmo rab tu rgyas byed cing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces dang / gang du skyes pa'i skye ba thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan thob par shog /skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad gyur ga

nas/ /tshul bzhin baji/ba pa'i rang dbang skyesad par 31ga /der yang bla ma dam pa mnyes byas nas/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /chos thob nas ni snying tsho rpā bsgrubs te/ /tshe des srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal bar shog /srid par dam pa'i chos rab ston byed cing / /gzhan phan sgrub la skyo ngal med par shog /rlabs chen gzhan don phyogs ris med pa yis/ /thams cad phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob par shog /'di kun mkhyen klong 'a pa'i gsung in/tsha mjug sdud kyi smon lam kun mkhyen padma dkar yo gis/ bde gshegs stoni pa'i bstan pa mchog gi mtsho/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i sprin 'phreng gis/ /bshad sgrub char gyis nyin bzhin rnam spel ba/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /sdom gsum nyin mo'i 'od dang rtag 112

'grogs shing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i dri bzang 'dzin pa'i dpyid/ /bstan 'dzin pasgro'i galho bo ci yang gis/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig /rnyed dang bkur sti'i chu klung rnams 'bab cing / /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen skye ba'i gnas/ /chos 'khor gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal rgya mtshoras/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang gyur cig / 7 bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcerdzom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /stsorton lam rnam dag 'grub par shog/ //lto sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos gci

bzhin smon lam 'grub par cerdzog 7 phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig / 7 rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam gcig pu ru/ /rgyal bas yerdzongs bsngags theg mchog rdzogs pa che/ /rgyal dbang padma'i ring lugs snga 'gyur ba'o/ /rgyal bstan dredags mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog / lto ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang / /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis phasnag / 7 bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng skusnangs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'gyor pa 114

rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /āob dang shes rig lhan khag gi mi rje lho po mar gisatsho rten shes lho sa sbyong 'bad mi dang rgyal yongs slob grwa khag gi na gzhon bu dang bumo tshu gisasnga phyi snyas lu thun gtang ni'i rpā lu thun bsdusapa byastabasabade tog to cig phyogs sgriga'abad dgosapa'i zhal bkod gnangam lasabarten phran thaming snying khu 'amakun bzang dbang ཿsarang gisasngonacan rgyalab gongam tshu gigasungabyinarlabagazhin tshu spyi lo 'phuzla tshesadang rang lugs sam lo sa yos zla dang pa'i yar tshes lu phyogs bsgrigs 'bad mi 'di gis rang dang 'dra ba'i blo dman pa sa gzhon cha mnyamalu phan thogasapa'i rgyu lu gyur cig/sarba /thi lam̐////

rgyal po'i brtan bzhugs/lto 'brug tsandan babordzod pa'i rgyal khab na/ /dpal lugs gnyis bstan srid skyong ba'i mgone/ /'brug rgyal po mnga' bdag rin po che/ /sku 'gyur med brtan cing chab srid 'phel/ /chos sangs rgyas bstan pa dar shing rgyas/ /'bangs bde skyid nyi ma shar bar shog /7 'brug tsandan bkod pa'i rgyal khab nang / /dgra yi phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /chos srid gnyisakyi longs spyod ldan/ /dga' ba 'dug go /skyid pa 'dug go /sman ྅rtongs 'brug gi rgyal khab nang / /mnga' 'bangs bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /dga' nyams skyid nyams spro nyams 'dug /dpal mi dbang mnga' bdag rgyal perdzo mchosgog /ri ga 7

gdung brgyud gter chen pad gling brgyud/ /mi dbang 'jigs med seng ge 'khrungs/ /dga' ba 'dug go /skyid pa 'dug go /mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po mchog /thugs rgyud bzang ba byang chub sems/ /mdzad spyode bzang ba phan bde che/ /lung bstan gyi mi dbang seng ge mchog /na gzhon dga' spro'i longs spyod dus/ /brgyud 'dzin bzhi pa'i gser khrir byon/ /dga' ba 'dug go /skyid pa 'dug go /kha bzhi 'brug pa'i mi ser lu/ /rnam par dkar ba'i thugs bzhed kyis/ /ris med 'bangs rnams bu bzhin skyong / /phyi rgyal khab gzhan dang mthun lam mdzad/ /nang gi mi ser byams kyis skyongs/ /yar rgyas rtsa ba gong du 118
